title: Kit Green's CIA files on UFO-related injuries given to Gary Nolan

tellings.quote: think the whatever CIA files around biological interactions from you know, people interacting with UFOs. That was given to um Gary Nolan in the like mid-2010s.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Kit Green, a scientist who worked for the CIA, held files on the bodily effects people suffered after close encounters with UFOs. According to Michels, those files were handed to another scientist, Garry Nolan, sometime in the mid-2010s. If true, it would mean the US spy agency had been quietly tracking injuries from such encounters.
